payload.description_html: Seabed still images reference collection from Wight-Barfleur Reef SCI (CEND 03/13). This survey was carried out to acquire data to delineate better the extent of Annex I reef (both bedrock and stony) within the area, which could be used to assist with the development of management advice in relation to the areas and features designated for conservation.
